title: Seagrove Beach "Freebird Seagrove" 135 Dogwood Street
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views - Located two blocks from the beach- Short walk to the beach and Seaside- Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1–May 1 for $35 per day**- Rooftop hot tub- Complimentary beach setups each morning include 2 beach chairs with 1 umbrellas (Mar 1-Oct 31)- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Free Standing Ice Maker- 7 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- In-home elevator- Fireplace- Complete Clean Linen Participant—All linens, including comforter, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled 2 blocks from the glittering Gulf, Freebird Seagrove offers a blissful beach getaway for 26 guests, boasting 7 beautiful bedrooms, 8.5 bathrooms, and ample amenities. Stargaze from the rooftop sitting spa, sunbathe by the private pool, or take advantage of the numerous living spaces made for entertaining large groups.A playful, contemporary design curates a welcoming atmosphere inside this 4-level home. The first-level game room is the perfect escape, featuring an L-shaped sofa, Smart TV, foosball table, classic arcade game, and kitchenette. Outside, a privacy fence offers peaceful seclusion for barbecuing on the grill, enjoying the shaded patio, or stretching out beside the sunlit pool. When bedtime arrives, choose between this level’s 3 guest bedrooms, each featuring a king bed. All the home’s bedrooms feature a private bathroom and Smart TV.The in-home elevator provides effortless access to the second level, where weathered beams and pale wood add a coastal touch to the open great room. Dual dark couches and 2 armchairs flank the fireplace and 65” Smart TV, equipped with a Sonos soundbar for elevated movie experiences. The fabulous kitchen is a chef’s dream with Thermador appliances, quartz countertops, and 2 dishwashers. Enjoy freshly prepared meals at the table for 10, with extra seating for 2 at the breakfast bar. Step outside the sliding doors, where a spacious screened-in porch with seating and a picnic-style table encourages relaxing or dining in the fresh air. Sleeping accommodations on this level include 2 guest bedrooms with king beds.The third floor features a kid-friendly playroom with beanbag seating, a Smart TV, and a cozy hideaway, alongside 2 bunk rooms—each outfitted with 2 full-over-full bunks.On the top floor, take in the sweeping bird’s-eye view while sneaking in a workout on the Peloton bike. A wet bar, loveseat, and Smart TV add comfort inside, while the rooftop patio’s sitting spa calls for peaceful nights beneath the stars.Savor a lavish getaway at Freebird Seagrove. Parking for 4 vehicles—plus 7 complimentary adult bikes and a 6-passenger low speed vehicle—makes it easy to explore Seagrove Beach and 30A. For beach access, follow Dogwood Street to East County Highway 30A, turn left, and the Dogwood-Thyme Beach Access will be on the right. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Separate - Half Bathroom: Toilet OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Two Full over Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Two Full over Full Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboFOURTH FLOOR:- Guest Bathroom: Shower/Tub Combo
